name: escapedfox
description: Use Firefox's built-in VPN (IP Protection) from the whole system, via a TUI (unofficial)

scripts.build: node -e "fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc && node -e "fs.chmodSync('dist/cli.js', 0o755)"
scripts.test: npm run build && node test/global.test.mjs && node test/proxy.test.mjs && node test/dns.test.mjs

author: Dier Cohen
